Options Trading Command Center

Offline (LocalStorage). Preloaded setups + key checklist + risk layers + mental routines.

Welcome

—
Recommended daily flow: Mental Exercises → Risk Layers (PASS) → Trade Logger → Journal → Analytics.

What’s enforced

Guardrails
  • Setup Key checklist: trade cannot save until Key items complete.
  • Trade sizing caps: contracts cap, position % cap, risk % cap (needs stop).
  • Day/Week stops: daily & weekly loss limits + consecutive loss gate.
  • Behavior gate: minimum mental score required to PASS pre-trade checklist.

What changes the plan

knobs
  • Your weekly loss limit and daily loss limit drive the risk budget.
  • Your max risk per trade (%) only applies if you use a stop.
  • As the account grows, the plan updates automatically (risk budgets scale).
  • If the goal requires weekly returns far above your risk budget, the plan will flag it as unrealistic and suggest a longer horizon.
